untested_conclusions: The comparison is same-sample: three arms read against each other on one frozen score panel, one fold geometry and one cost stack. It can kill a configuration and it cannot promote one; no arm promotes out of this registration (§3.13, [promotion_rule]).

The calibration's training cross-section is the formation window's point-in-time membership at the fit cutoff, without the per-bar eligibility screen the decision path applies; the screen is applied at every decision bar and to the labels' universe, not bar by bar inside the training pool.

The frozen dataset carries no cash-distribution events, so the 'credited' label of §3.4 credits zero and the accounting credits zero; the two agree, and neither establishes what a dividend-bearing panel would have produced.

charged_cost_conventions.held_identical: the frozen cost stack and the rules that apply it, at every capital level and for every arm
charged_cost_conventions.not_identical: charged dollars: participation is trade dollars over dollar volume from current equity, impact is charged on filled notional, and rounding at the per-sid increment changes filled notional, so charged cost varies with account size by construction. Freezing charged costs at one capital level would defeat the sweep.
